decisions.reason: Relocating and reorienting the sensor-board connectors does not change their electrical partition, types, references, pinouts, or power-chain roles.
The source changes sensor-board connector placement and orientation, not the main-board dimensions or fit constraints.
The source concerns lower connectors on the sensor board and does not alter power-board connector placement, orientation, or accessibility.
Moving existing sensor-board connectors does not change the number, identity, or separation of project boards.
Connector relocation on the sensor board does not change the main board's four-layer stack.
The sensor-board connector layout change does not affect ESP32 antenna placement or clearance on the main board.
The source does not change the power board's dimensions, mounting, installation orientation, or USB-C placement.

The connector inventory, fanout roles, connector types, signals, and consolidation policy remain unchanged; only physical placement and access orientation change, which are already owned by the source Requirement.
Sensor-board connector relocation does not change monitored rails, monitor hardware, channel count, or measurement coverage.
The source does not alter standalone USB power activation, regulation, source selection, or the powered 3.3V load set.
Connector placement and orientation do not change DCDC1 voltage, current rating, compensation, or rail-regulation behavior.
The source concerns sensor-board connectors and does not change the main-board panel-control connector inventory or control signals.
